title: Perseus (X4: Foundations)
intro: The Perseus is a small Paranid fighter with two forward guns, the fastest of the fighters listed in JoyPro. It uses the shared X4 flight controls.

panels.name: Perseus: seat and weapons
panels.text: Facts about the Perseus that set it apart from other X4 ships: where the pilot sits and which guns, turrets and docking it has.
panels.context: All other controls of the Perseus are the shared X4 controls of this guide.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The Perseus is flown from a cockpit seat, as small and medium ships are. The pilot sits here and has all the controls of this guide.
controls.context: From this seat the pilot sees the HUD, the radar and the monitors of the Perseus.

controls.name: Forward guns
controls.text: The Perseus has two forward guns that point where the nose points. The pilot fires them with the trigger and aims by turning the whole ship.
controls.context: The aiming mark in front of the target on the HUD shows where to point the nose.

controls.name: Speed
controls.text: The Perseus is the fastest of the fighters listed in JoyPro.
controls.context: Speed lets the pilot choose when to fight and when to leave.
